name: Coronado, Panama

rent.notes: Paraiso Village 3BR rents for $1,100 plus a $175 HOA that covers security, water and garbage. A Coronado 3BR that allows pets lists at $1,200 and an older 2BR pet-friendly listing was $850. Most listings do not state a pet policy, so confirm the landlord accepts a 100 lb dog. A $3,200 furnished beach house was left out as an outlier.

groceries.notes: The 2026 Live and Invest budget puts couple groceries at $400. Dog food for a 100 lb dog (about 40-50 lb a month) adds roughly $50-100 a month, based on February 2023 Panama bag prices: Dog Chow 55 lb $45-60, Victor 50 lb $97.

utilities.notes: Beach-town electricity runs $80-250+ a month depending on how much A/C you use. Water and garbage are $10-20 and a large propane tank is $12-20. The 2026 Live and Invest Coronado budget totals $155 ($125 electricity, $20 water and trash, $10 gas). Internet is excluded.

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

insurance.notes: Renters (contents) insurance placeholder. Insurers in Panama do not publish home premiums, and ExpatDen (Oct 2026) says to get a broker quote. The old stored value meant health insurance and has been replaced.

petDaycare.notes: National boarding rates are $10-30 a night (2025 source). The monthly figures assume 6-8 nights a month, with a large dog at the upper end of the price range. No Coronado-specific facility pricing was found.

sources.title: Relofirm - Pets in Panama (boarding $10-30/night, grooming $20-40)

petGrooming.notes: Full grooming costs $20-40 nationally (2025). Coronado groomers charge $14-30 depending on size (undated source). These assume about one groom a month for a Bernese double coat, priced at the large-dog end.

sources.title: Relofirm - Pets in Panama

transportation.notes: Car insurance is $500-900 a year ($42-75 a month) and upkeep is about $200-350 a year. Local fuel is $30-100 a month. Gasoline is about $1.18-1.26 per liter (July 2026). One or two round trips to Panama City (about 180 km) add roughly $22-44 a month in fuel.

entertainment.notes: Mas Movil 600 Mbps symmetric fiber is $39 a month (June 2026 promo). ExpatDen calls Coronado gated-community internet adequate, so confirm fiber at the specific address. The 2026 Live and Invest budget lists $80 for internet plus streaming and $350 for entertainment.

medicalOOP.notes: A 2026 estimate puts general doctor visits at $40-80 and specialists at $60-120. These figures assume several general visits and a couple of specialist visits a year for each of you, plus labs and medications. Major specialists are in Panama City, and that travel is counted under transportation.
